LanguageData.WWX.ColonistEnable: Roll join rewards from my xenotype list
LanguageData.WWX.ColonistEnableTip: The "Random colonist joins" rewards are hardcoded to baseliners. With this on they roll from the list below instead. Turn it off to leave Winston Waves' reward pawns alone.
LanguageData.WWX.IncludeHemogenTip: Off by default, so sanguophages and anything else that runs on hemogen stay exclusive to the sanguophage reward - the way Winston Waves had it. Turn this on to let them turn up as ordinary colonists too.
LanguageData.WWX.IncludeMutantsTip: Winston Waves' ghoul and shambler rewards are humans underneath, forced to baseliner like the rest. Mutating a pawn only disables a couple of named genes, so a pigskin ghoul still looks like a pigskin. On by default.
LanguageData.WWX.IncludeWarcasketsTip: The VFE Pirates warcasket rewards are humans in a tin can, also forced to baseliner. You will only see the difference when they come out of the casket. On by default.
LanguageData.WWX.NoneSelectedColonists: Nothing selected - join rewards will keep giving baseliners.
LanguageData.WWX.NonCombatantNote: Xenotypes that cannot be generated as combatants, such as highmates, are not listed - Winston Waves only hands out pawns capable of violence.
LanguageData.WWX.SanguophageEnable: Roll sanguophage rewards from my xenotype list
LanguageData.WWX.SanguophageEnableTip: Winston Waves' sanguophage rewards are locked to vanilla's sanguophage plus three from Vanilla Races Expanded. With this on they roll from every hemogen xenotype you have loaded instead.
LanguageData.WWX.SanguophageExplain: Every xenotype below carries a gene that runs on hemogen. Tick nothing to use all of them.
LanguageData.WWX.NoneSelectedSanguophages: Nothing selected - every hemogen xenotype is used.
LanguageData.WWX.NoCandidates: No xenotypes here. Add some xenotype mods, or tick "Include hemogen xenotypes" on the colonist tab.
